preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Deliver a playable, authoritative A→B→C objective spine on the intact authored map while closing the bounded weapon-impact causality defect, preserving clean boot, locomotion, map integrity, and both accepted first-person weapon configurations.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate stops at an Alpha-only overlap probe: it has no authoritative mission controller, Bravo/Charlie objectives, ordered key and route state, checkpoint snapshots, defusal stages, or mission countdown. Separately, the authoritative weapon path commits ammo and controlled-target damage exactly once, but world-impact creation remains inside the non-damageable blocked branch and is not keyed idempotently by shot ID, so valid target hits have no corresponding world-space response.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, duplicate, extract, reposition, or edit child meshes of the intact authored environment; stop and report navigation/bounds evidence if grounded Bravo or Charlie anchors cannot be placed without map surgery or proxy roads/floors.
Do not replace or split the accepted AK-74M/Saiga-12 hands, skeletons, animations, profiles, audio, or effects while repairing impact dispatch.
Do not expand this iteration into enemy AI, full minimap/HUD, story media, finale cinematics, decorative environment work, or other unverified domination-expansion backlog checks.
Do not claim completion if clean boot, the accepted spawn-to-Alpha route, exactly-once shot damage, or immutable per-weapon ammo/fire-mode state regresses.
Completion requires host/Tester pass verdicts for both required checks; Developer self-reports or debug labels alone are insufficient.

strategy.rationale: Introduce one mission authority that owns timer, objective order, keys, route gates, defusal, and checkpoint snapshots, with objective nodes acting only as observers/adapters. In parallel, move collision impact dispatch behind the finalized immutable shot receipt so hit and blocked results share one idempotent observer without disturbing accepted damage, weapon, viewmodel, or map behavior.

code: Load/parse all changed GDScript and scenes with no errors or missing resources; verify signal and NodePath bindings for mission authority, A/B/C adapters, player damage/restart, and weapon impacts.

Audit that only the mission controller mutates timer, keys, route legality, checkpoint versions, bomb stages, and terminal state; presentation nodes must be read-only observers with stable event IDs and idempotent handlers.
Audit shot receipt construction and impact dispatch so each shot has one ammo commit, at most one damage commit, and at most one impact commit; misses must have zero impact commits.
Confirm one intact authored-environment instance and the accepted coupled AK-74M/Saiga-12 viewmodel resources remain bound; no imported source asset or authored child transform is modified.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester reruns `clean_boot` and preserved bootstrap/arena checks before evaluating the two required gaps.

For `domination_expansion_objective_progression`, capture one continuous ordinary-input state timeline covering locked Bravo, Alpha capture/key/checkpoint, restored Alpha checkpoint, Bravo capture/key/checkpoint, locked then accessible Charlie, leave and damage interruptions, all three completed stages, and timer behavior. Compare event IDs, commit counts, remaining time, player/objective overlap.
visual: Tester captures sparse shipped-camera views at Alpha, Bravo, and Charlie from approach plus center/edge states needed to expose locked, active/interrupted, and secured/completed behavior. Fail floating/clipped markers, near-plane curtains, reticle occlusion, roof/void placement, or presentation inconsistent with authoritative state.

Using transient-frame capture, Tester records AK and Saiga target-hit frames plus a blocked-surface frame and miss control, then aligns each visible impact's world position/lifetime with its shot receipt, ammo, and damage state.

Compare objective hierarchy and cyan/amber threat language against the supplied imagination reference only as art-direction guidance; do not require copied commercial HUD composition or expand validation into the deferred full-HUD/minimap surface.

done_when: A fresh ordinary-input run exposes physically separated, grounded Alpha and Bravo capture volumes and a distinct Charlie bomb interaction volume on the accepted authored map, with readable non-occluding approach and in-volume presentation.

Alpha alone advances from enemy-held through active capture to secured after the configured 12 seconds; it atomically commits the first unique key, unlocks the next route, and writes checkpoint version 1 exactly once. Bravo cannot progress beforehand and, once legal, independently commits key 2, unlocks Charlie, and writes checkpoint version 2 exactly once.

Charlie exposes only the currently legal diagnosis, power-isolation, or detonator-removal interaction. The three configured stages total 18 seconds, completed stages stay latched, and leaving the radius or receiving authoritative damage interrupts only the active stage with an event-bound reason.

The five-minute timer has one owner, advances during active gameplay including capture and defusal holds, does not pause merely because the player enters an objective, and stops only on a terminal mission state or true pause.

Checkpoint restore returns the player and authoritative mission snapshot—remaining time, objective states, keys, route locks, bomb stages, checkpoint version, health, and weapon/ammo state—without granting time or duplicating commits, signals, or nodes.

Mission telemetry exposes stable event IDs and bounded histories for capture start/progress/interruption/completion, key commit, route unlock, checkpoint commit/restore, defusal start/interruption/completion, timer ticks, and terminal submission; presentation observes these records rather than creating truth.

The authored environment remains one intact runtime instance, existing collision/navigation and spawn-to-Alpha behavior remain valid, and no proxy floor, decorative roadblock, or authored-child transform change is introduced.
tasks.instructions: Replace the Alpha-only placeholder authority with a single candidate-owned mission controller and thin A/B capture and C bomb adapters. Ground Bravo and Charlie on distinct native walkable locations selected from the intact map topology, retain Alpha and the fixed spawn, and model explicit spawn→A, A→B, and B→C main/flank/fallback route edges. Use bounded product-owned gameplay gates only at valid authored thresholds; do not alter the map package or add decorative barriers. The controller must own mission phase, a configurable 300-second timer, A/B capture state, two unique keys, route legality, versioned checkpoint snapshots, C's three ordered stages, interruption, and atomic terminal submission. Wire ordinary interact input and an authoritative player-damage signal/API; adapt F6 restart to restore the latest legal checkpoint rather than resetting mission truth. Preserve current locomotion, camera, collision, and weapon bindings. Add compact player-facing objective progress/prompts sufficient to understand locked, active, interrupted, and secured states, but do not implement the full HUD/minimap/story backlog. Developer self-validation matrix: locked-B attempt; Alpha enter/leave/capture; Alpha checkpoint restore after elapsed time; Bravo capture; Charlie premature attempt; diagnosis hold; leave-radius interruption; damage interruption; isolation; detonator removal while remaining_time>0. Record state before and after every transition and prove each commit count is one. Visible-family plan: family_id=`objective_world_affordances`; prd_style_match=`grounded tactical cyan-white Aegis progression against restrained amber-red locked/threat states, following the supplied imagination reference's compact hierarchy without copying it`; source_quality_class=`product-owned world-space gameplay affordance over the accepted authored environment`; material_and_texture_evidence=`inspect actual runtime opacity, emission, depth occlusion, edge cleanliness, and daylight readability`; expected_runtime_uses_or_visible_area_share=`.
tasks.title: Build the authoritative A→B→C mission spine

done_when: Every accepted non-miss collision finalizes one immutable receipt and dispatches exactly one bounded world-space impact keyed by that receipt's shot ID; controlled-target hits and blocked world collisions both work, while misses create no impact.

AK-74M and Saiga-12 controlled hits each show one ammo commit, one ballistic result, one damage commit, and one corresponding hit-impact commit at the reported position/normal with a bounded lifetime.

Repeated delivery of the same shot receipt cannot create another impact, damage commit, score event, or presentation commit; impact telemetry reports shot ID, result, position, normal, variant, spawn count, and expiry.

Blocked and hit responses remain meaningfully distinguishable by geometry/motion/timing rather than palette alone, stay world-occluded and small at human scale, and do not become HUD labels or full-screen effects.

SEMI press-edge behavior, AUTO hold/release cadence, ADS, switching, tactical/empty reload, dry fire, per-weapon ammo ownership, existing muzzle/recoil/animation/audio, and accepted viewmodel/map bindings remain unchanged.
tasks.instructions: Repair the existing controller rather than replacing weapon or feedback components. Finalize hit, blocked, or miss first, then route hit and blocked receipts through one idempotent impact observer keyed by immutable shot ID; remove branch-local ownership that currently excludes damageable hits. Preserve exactly-once damage and all accepted weapon/viewmodel state. Reuse and refine the existing bounded `ShotImpact` mechanism: supply shot ID, result, hit position, surface normal, variant, and lifetime, maintain a small commit registry/history for inspection, and clean it safely on expiry/restart. Developer self-validation matrix: AK hit, Saiga hit, blocked map shot, miss, repeated-receipt rejection, SEMI press/hold, AUTO hold/release, switch-and-fire, and reload-then-fire. Visible-family plan: family_id=`weapon_foundation_world_impacts`; prd_style_match=`brief grounded world-space contact response, readable in daylight and subordinate to the target/map`; source_quality_class=`existing candidate-owned bounded procedural impact mechanism`; material_and_texture_evidence=`inspect emitted materials and actual runtime blending/occlusion against the calibration target and authored surfaces, rejecting halos or edge contamination`; expected_runtime_uses_or_visible_area_share=`2–15 concurrent/recent bounded effects with sub-percent visible area`; minimum_distinct_source_variants=`2`; minimum_runtime_variants=`2`; maximum_single_variant_share=`0.75`; diversity_axes=`damageable-hit versus blocked-surface geometry, motion, timing, normal alignment, and scale—not tint alone`; background_mode=`native world-space transparency with no screen background`; runtime_evidence_views=`AK target hit, Saiga target hit, blocked authored surface, and unchanged-frame miss`.
